recipes.title: Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Cream together butter and sugars until smooth. 3. Beat in eggs one at a time. 4. Add vanilla. 5. Combine dry ingredients and gradually mix in. 6. Fold in chocolate chips. 7. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto baking sheets. 8. Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.author: Grandma Helen

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chili
recipes.instructions: 1. Sauté onion and peppers until soft. 2. Add garlic and spices, cook 2 minutes. 3. Add beans and tomatoes. 4. Simmer for 30 minutes. 5. Season to taste. 6. Serve hot with your favorite toppings.
recipes.author: Chef Maria

recipes.title: Classic Caesar Salad
recipes.instructions: 1. Wash and chop romaine lettuce. 2. Toss with dressing. 3. Top with Parmesan cheese and croutons. 4. Squeeze lemon over top. 5. Serve immediately.
recipes.author: Community Member

recipes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
recipes.instructions: 1. Brown beef in batches. 2. Sauté onion and garlic. 3. Add beef back with vegetables. 4. Add broth, tomato paste, and herbs. 5. Simmer 2-3 hours until tender.
recipes.author: Chef James

recipes.title: Lemon Blueberry Muffins
recipes.instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Cream butter and sugar. 3. Add eggs and lemon zest. 4. Mix dry ingredients and alternate with milk. 5. Fold in blueberries. 6. Fill muffin tins and bake 20-25 minutes.
recipes.author: Baker Sarah

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to package. 2. Fry pancetta until crispy. 3. Beat eggs with cheese. 4. Combine hot pasta with pancetta and egg mixture. 5. Stir quickly to create creamy sauce. 6. Season and serve immediately.
recipes.author: Chef Antonio

recipes.title: Quinoa Salad with Vegetables
recipes.instructions: 1. Cook quinoa according to package. 2. Let cool. 3. Chop all vegetables. 4. Combine quinoa and vegetables. 5. Add feta and dressing. 6. Toss and chill before serving.
recipes.author: Health Coach Lisa

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon with Herb Butter
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix butter with herbs. 2. Season salmon. 3. Grill salmon 4-6 minutes per side. 4. Top with herb butter. 5. Serve with lemon slices.
recipes.author: Grill Master Mike
